title: Q-resafe: Assessing Safety Risks and Quantization-aware Safety Patching for Quantized Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and restoring the 'safety' of LLMs, which it explicitly defines as preventing the generation of 'harmful content or violating ethical norms.' It utilizes safety benchmarks such as AdvBench and metrics like Attack Success Rate (ASR) to assess the ethical alignment of quantized models, making this a core component of the research rather than a side section.
